messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from today's arch sync — proposal to move policy decision logic into a lightweight sidecar + central policy map. TL;DR: sidecars keep local token buckets for low-latency; central policy map pushes updates and resolves cross-client fairness. Thoughts?

ara: I like the hybrid idea. Does central map handle quota resets and long-term fairness windows (1h/24h)?

sam: Yes — central map stores leases and global counters. Sidecars use short-lived leases (50-200ms) to refill local buckets. If lease fails sidecar falls back to conservative local refill.

karim: Concern: lease granularity — doing leases every 200ms per sidecar * 1000 sidecars = a lot of writes. We should avoid a hot central write path. Maybe use push-based deltas from map + probabilistic spillover?

devin: Alternative: use consistent hashing to shard global counters into N shards, sidecars talk to specific shard leader; reduces cross-shard contention. Adds complexity for failover though.

ara: For abuse cases we need global detection (patterns across many sidecars). Central map can emit alerts on heavy cross-shard spikes if leader aggregates.

sam: On storage: Redis with RL module vs Raft-backed store (etcd/consul). Redis is lowest-latency but single-tenant failure modes. Raft gives stronger consistency but higher tail latency. We could run Redis Cluster per-region plus tombstone strategy for migration.

devin: Also think about fairness across customers: implement per-customer weight + slow-start ramp. We need deterministic tie-breaking when capacity low.

karim: How do we handle dedicated vs hosted tenants? Dedicated should bypass central throttles (customer-owned pool) but still need abuse gates. Maybe sidecar reads 'deployment_mode' flag from policy map.

maya: ops-bot noticed CI flake when running rate-limiter tests against mock-policy-map. Stacktrace attached: ```TimeoutError: rpc timeout to policy-map: I/O 1200ms``` Might indicate we need better test harness.

sam: Proposed API between sidecar and policy-map:
- GetPolicy(customer_id) -> {rate, burst, priority, mode}
- LeaseTokens(customer_id, shard_id, tokens, lease_ms) -> {granted, remaining}
- PushMetrics(batch)

karim: Small nit: prefer gRPC unary for GetPolicy (cacheable) and streaming for leases to amortize IO.

ara: We should add per-route annotations in config so sidecars can enforce route-specific quotas (e.g., embeddings vs chat). Also include model-level token weighting.

devin: Rollout plan:
1) Feature-flag sidecar local buckets (opt-in) on a small canary pool
2) Enable central map read-only -> verify metrics alignment
3) Bump to full lease mode
4) Enable shard leaders and failover tests
5) Gradual expansion

sam: Open questions: eviction policy for sidecar buckets on restart, metric cardinality explosion, and how to backfill counters after failover.

maya: +1 to canary plan. I'll make a runbook for rollback triggers (latency spikes, error rate > 0.5%).

sam: I'll follow up with an RFC draft with diagrams. tagging @karim @ara for input. :thumbsup:

devin: One more: we need to include a 'grace' token for interactive requests (low latency) so UX isn't broken. Implement as small always-available reserve per-customer.

sam: Thanks — I'll drop the RFC link when ready.
